Subject: POC Prompt Lab — workshop slot and outline (proposed)

Hi Alex / Sarah,

Thanks again for agreeing to run a hands-on prompt lab as part of the POC. To keep the session actionable, we want to:

- Do a short prompt inventory review (30–45 mins)
- Walk routing and structured-output guardrails (30 mins)
- Run a light load test (30 mins) to validate latency under realistic concurrency

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Mar 2 — 09:00–12:00 (3h block)
- Wed Mar 3 — 13:00–16:00 (3h block)
- Thu Mar 4 — 10:00–13:00 (3h block)

Please reply with your preferred slot and any participants we should include. I attached a blank prompt_inventory_v1.csv for you to pre-fill a few example prompts (intent, sample input, expected structured output). Also attaching a draft load_test_plan_v2.pdf for the test we plan to run.

Prework ask (light): please share 8–10 representative prompts by Feb 26 so we can pre-configure routing profiles and KV caches.

If any of these slots don't work, I can shift — we have limited shared calendar availability the week of Mar 1.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: prompt_inventory_v1.csv (spreadsheet), load_test_plan_v2.pdf (PDF)

Thanks, this looks great. We can do Wed Mar 3 13:00–16:00 PT. Sarah and I will be there; I'll also loop in our ML infra lead if we need to discuss network traffic shaping for the load test.

Quick notes:
- We'll send 10 prompts by Feb 25 (I can attach a CSV)
- For the load test, we prefer the 30-min steady-state at ~20 RPS (per the doc) rather than bursts; happy to align on exact requests per second during the session

I'll add the slot to my calendar tentatively.
